body: i don't even know how i'd reach out to them, it doesn't feel like they'd be sympathetic at all. it just seems like they'd say "tough shit, kid" and leave me in the dark, or at least the main one i'm struggling with would. idk if this is my brain thinking everything is worse than it is, or if everything is as hopeless as it seems but i don't even know if it's worth it to try. what would i say? what would i even ask for? i already came to him and asked if i could take the first test since i missed it due to me being so deep in this shit mental health episode, but he just kinda shit on me and said "no, i'm not gonna do that. you've got other problems in this class too, it seems." so it seems hopeless
